description: A React functional component 'ChatUI' that provides a comprehensive chat interface for testing various LLM endpoints, editing models, managing session states, uploading media, and integrating with external tools. It handles user input, response rendering, various media types, and includes extensive state management and side effects for fetching models, agents, and tools.

methods.name: loadMCPTools
methods.description: Fetches available MCP tools using the provided API key or access token and updates state.

methods.name: useEffect (loading MCP Tools)
methods.description: Triggers fetch of MCP tools when MCP modal becomes visible.

methods.name: useEffect (generate code snippet)
methods.description: Generates a code snippet when the 'Get Code' modal is visible, updating state with the code.

methods.name: useEffect (persist chat state)
methods.description: Debounced storage of chat history and session variables into sessionStorage.

methods.name: useEffect (fetch models and sync session data)
methods.description: Fetches available models on relevant dependency changes, and updates session storage accordingly.

methods.name: useEffect (fetch agents for A2A endpoint)
methods.description: Fetches available agents when the endpoint type is A2A agents.

methods.name: useEffect (scroll chat to bottom)
methods.description: Automatically scrolls chat to bottom whenever chatHistory updates.

methods.name: updateTextUI
methods.description: Appends or creates a new assistant message in chat history with the given text chunk.

methods.name: updateReasoningContent
methods.description: Updates reasoningContent field in the latest assistant message.

methods.name: updateTimingData
methods.description: Updates timeToFirstToken in the latest assistant message.

methods.name: updateUsageData
methods.description: Updates usage (tokens, etc.) in the latest assistant message.

methods.name: updateA2AMetadata
methods.description: Adds A2A-related metadata to the latest assistant message.

methods.name: updateTotalLatency
methods.description: Updates totalLatency in the latest assistant message.

methods.name: updateSearchResults
methods.description: Associates search results with the latest assistant message.

methods.name: handleResponseId
methods.description: Stores the response ID if API session management is enabled.

methods.name: handleToggleSessionManagement
methods.description: Enables or disables API session management, clearing session ID if disabled.

methods.name: handleMCPEvent
methods.description: Updates MCP events list with new events, filtering duplicates.

methods.name: updateImageUI
methods.description: Adds an image message to chat history.

methods.name: updateEmbeddingsUI
methods.description: Adds embeddings content to chat history.

methods.name: updateAudioUI
methods.description: Adds an audio message to chat history.

methods.name: updateChatImageUI
methods.description: Attaches an image to the latest assistant message, creating a new message if needed.

methods.name: handleKeyDown
methods.description: Handles Enter key press to send a message.

methods.name: handleCancelRequest
methods.description: Cancels ongoing request.

methods.name: handleImageUpload
methods.description: Uploads an image, generates preview URL, and updates state.

methods.name: handleRemoveImage
methods.description: Removes a specific uploaded image.

methods.name: handleRemoveAllImages
methods.description: Removes all uploaded images and revokes their URLs.

methods.name: handleResponsesImageUpload
methods.description: Uploads response image and updates state.

methods.name: handleRemoveResponsesImage
methods.description: Removes response image and URL.

methods.name: handleChatImageUpload
methods.description: Uploads chat image and updates state.

methods.name: handleRemoveChatImage
methods.description: Removes chat image and URL.

methods.name: handleAudioUpload
methods.description: Uploads audio file.

methods.name: handleRemoveAudio
methods.description: Removes uploaded audio.

methods.name: handleSendMessage
methods.description: Main function to validate input, prepare API calls, manage state during response, and handle various endpoint types.

methods.name: clearChatHistory
methods.description: Resets chat history and related session states, revokes object URLs, and clears stored data.

methods.name: onModelChange
methods.description: Updates selected model and toggles custom input state.
